recreation_brief:
1. Canvas: create a blank slide with a solid background fill of light warm gray #E9E9E7 (no gradient, texture, or theme graphics).
2. Element 1 - red frame: draw one rectangle with square corners, Fill = No Fill, Line = solid dark red #C00000 at ~1.75 pt weight (source range 1.5-2 pt); position it inset 6% of slide width from the left, 6% from the right, and 8% of slide height from the top, with the bottom edge at 96% of slide height so it meets the top of the bottom bar (on a 16:9 canvas of 13.33 in x 7.5 in: x = 0.80 in, y = 0.60 in, w = 11.73 in, h = 6.60 in).
3. Element 2 - title: insert one text box spanning 20%-80% of slide width and 30%-70% of slide height (16:9: x = 2.67 in, y = 2.25 in, w = 8.00 in, h = 3.00 in) with paragraph alignment = Center; type line 1 exactly '[3] Quick revision of', then one empty paragraph, then line 2 exactly 'Neural Netwok (NN)' - keep the typo 'Netwok' verbatim and flag it to the slide owner, do not correct it; format both lines as Arial Bold (or equivalent bold sans-serif), ~57 pt (source range 54-60 pt), font color #C00000, single spacing, no italics, no all-caps; the empty paragraph should place line 1 near ~40% and line 2 near ~64% of slide height.
4. Element 3 - bottom black bar (screen-recording artifact, not original slide content): draw one solid #000000 rectangle across the full slide width at the very bottom edge, height ~3.5% of slide height (16:9: y = 7.24 in, h = 0.26 in); skip this step if reproducing only the original slide design.
5. Element 4 - cursor artifact (screen-recording artifact, optional): place one small mouse-pointer arrow icon (black fill, thin white outline, tilted arrow shape, ~0.2 in tall - exact size not specified in source) at the far-left edge, vertically centered at ~45% of slide height; skip this step if reproducing only the original slide design.
6. Add nothing else: no bullets, labels, equations, footers, slide numbers, logos, photographs, charts, or decorative icons - the source slide contains none.
